mapper.insert: insert into oms_order_payment_check (order_id, channel, out_trade_no, query_status, channel_trade_state, channel_transaction_id, channel_total_fen, saved_status, saved_transaction_id, saved_pay_amount_fen, verdict, detail, error_message, operator_id, query_time) values (#{orderId}, #{channel}, #{outTradeNo}, #{queryStatus}, #{channelTradeState}, #{channelTransactionId}, #{channelTotalFen}, #{savedStatus}, #{savedTransactionId}, #{savedPayAmountFen}, #{verdict}, #{detail}, #{errorMessage}, #{operatorId}, #{queryTime})
mapper.select: select id, order_id, channel, out_trade_no, query_status, channel_trade_state, channel_transaction_id, channel_total_fen, saved_status, saved_transaction_id, saved_pay_amount_fen, verdict, detail, error_message, operator_id, query_time from oms_order_payment_check where order_id = #{orderId} order by id desc limit 1
